```{=html}
<section class="band band-slim band-green">
  <div class="band-narrow">

    <p class="eyebrow-lg">Registry</p>

    <p class="subtitle">
      Your presence is your present, and truly no gift is required. However, if you would like to
      purchase something to help us celebrate, below are some of the items we would love to
      receive.
    </p>

  </div>
</section>

<section class="band band-cream">
  <div class="band-inner">

    <div class="registry-card">

      <p style="line-height:1.8; max-width:520px; margin:0 auto 2.2rem">
        We have created our registry using Zola. All of our items are housed there, and anything
        purchased will ship directly to our address.
      </p>

      <!-- Zola's own widget, per their custom-website instructions. This is
           the most of the registry that can live on our page: Zola sends
           X-Frame-Options SAMEORIGIN, so the full registry cannot be framed. -->
      <div class="zola-embed-frame">
        <a class="zola-registry-embed"
           href="https://www.zola.com/registry/gabrielleandrileyjune19/"
           data-registry-key="gabrielleandrileyjune19">Our Zola Wedding Registry</a>
      </div>

    </div>

  </div>
</section>

<!-- Zola's official registry widget. It enhances the link above; if the script
     fails to load, the link still works on its own. -->
<script>
!function (e, t, n) {
  var s, a = e.getElementsByTagName(t)[0];
  e.getElementById(n) || (
    s = e.createElement(t),
    s.id = n,
    s.async = !0,
    s.src = "https://widget.zola.com/js/widget.js",
    a.parentNode.insertBefore(s, a)
  )
}(document, "script", "zola-wjs");
</script>
```
